title: The Fall of Babylon
notes: This chunk is a high-density similitude assembly: Exodus plagues, rod-serpent-rod, come-out call, north spoiler, and stone-sinking lock the Fall of Babylon to the first deliverance with tight Hebrew work (matteh, chazaq, tsaphon, shaqed) and clean cross-text. The rod-to-almond resurrection arc and the double grip on chazaq are especially strong. Residual house-style defects cluster on director cues (Mark, watch) and And-opened author sentences forbidden outside scripture. The modern landscaping metaphor appears twice and undercuts the mountain-into-sea image the chapter itself is proving. Grammar and internal naming are otherwise clean; no doctrine or quote wording needs touch.

This chunk is dense, assertive, and well-chained: the Babylon/Jonah contrast, the three spiritual names on Jerusalem, and the Exodus shore-song close all land with force and without hedging. The identification work is clear and law-positive. Residual defects are narrow: one opening director cue and one author-prose sentence that begins with And. No doctrine, quote, or symbol changes are needed; the rest of the prose already matches house density and voice.

proposals.old: Mark who can wear that name.
proposals.new: Only a covenant people can wear that name.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids Mark-that staging. The next sentence already proves the claim, so assert it directly.

proposals.old: And this great city is identified by its crime scene: __“the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and sym:sym-egypt[Egypt], *where also our Lord was crucified*”__ (Revelation 11:8) — Jerusalem.
proposals.new: This great city is identified by its crime scene: __“the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and sym:sym-egypt[Egypt], *where also our Lord was crucified*”__ (Revelation 11:8) — Jerusalem.
proposals.summary: Drop leading And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author sentences must not open with And outside scripture quotes.

proposals.old: And she wears her name where the sym:sym-seal[seal] goes: upon the forehead — the counterfeit inscription in the counterfeit place.
proposals.new: She wears her name where the sym:sym-seal[seal] goes: upon the forehead — the counterfeit inscription in the counterfeit place.
proposals.summary: Drop leading And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style bars And-starts in author prose.

proposals.old: And watch the dragon wield that member:
proposals.rationale: Combines a forbidden sentence-open with a watch cue. Assert the action instead.

proposals.old: And mark what an almond *is*: a fruit that is itself a sym:sym-seed[seed] — and __“the seed is the *word of God*”__ (Luke 8:11).
proposals.new: An almond *is* a fruit that is itself a sym:sym-seed[seed] — and __“the seed is the *word of God*”__ (Luke 8:11).
proposals.summary: Remove And-mark staging; assert the identification.
proposals.rationale: Director cue and And-open both violate house style. The claim stands without the prompt.

proposals.old: Mark the quarter the destruction enters by.
proposals.new: The destruction enters by a fixed quarter.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids Mark-that staging. Restate as assertion before the proof texts.

proposals.old: A mountain is a kingdom and a tree is a nation; what faith commands into the sea is not landscaping — it is Babylon's sentence, spoken by the household of faith.
proposals.new: A mountain is a kingdom and a tree is a nation; what faith commands into the sea is not about dirt — it is Babylon's sentence, spoken by the household of faith.
proposals.rationale: Landscaping is a modern image that fights the biblical mountain-into-sea judgment the chapter is proving. Keep the contrast with popular misreading without the stock modernism.

proposals.old: Faith that moves mountains was never about landscaping either — it is the saints praying down the destroying mountain, and being heard.
proposals.new: Faith that moves mountains was never about dirt either — it is the saints praying down the destroying mountain, and being heard.
proposals.rationale: Same modernism as the prior line. Keep the parallel contrast without the AI-register word.

proposals.old: Mark the exact wording of the sentence, because the going-down is not the verdict.
proposals.new: The exact wording of the sentence is decisive, because the going-down is not the verdict.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids presenter staging such as Mark that / Mark the. Assert the claim in the author’s voice without a cue.

proposals.old: And the verse says the other two names are what that city is called *spiritually* — the very kind of name the woman wears on her forehead: __“MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF sym:sym-harlot[HARLOTS]”__ (Revelation 17:5) — a mystery-name, a spiritual name.
proposals.new: The verse says the other two names are what that city is called *spiritually* — the very kind of name the woman wears on her forehead: __“MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF sym:sym-harlot[HARLOTS]”__ (Revelation 17:5) — a mystery-name, a spiritual name.
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style bans author-prose sentences that open with And/But/That. Removing the conjunction keeps the claim intact.
